name: grandma-wei
description: Take a photo of your room. Grandma Wei reads its feng shui and tells you, lovingly, what to fix.

scripts.qi: cd crates/qi && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 wasm-pack build --release --target web --scope gw --out-dir ../../packages/qi --out-name qi -- --features wasm && rm -f ../../packages/qi/.gitignore
scripts.build: bun run qi && bun run --cwd apps/web build
